data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gorgeos', meaning 'valiant' or 'honorable'. In Greek mythology, a 'georgos' was a farmer or a warrior. The name Gorges signifies strength, power, and valor, and was given to boys to instill courage and determination. The name Gorges carries the meaning “A mighty and powerful one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gorges usually hope their child will grow to embody a mighty and powerful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
